name: hackupc-planstack-spike
description: Spike: copy phase prompt to clipboard and optionally executeCommand to focus Cursor Composer.

hackupc.nativeHandoff.openComposerComman.description: Optional. VS Code command ID to open or focus Cursor Composer/Agent after the prompt is copied. Find it via Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P), search for the panel you want, click the gear → Copy Command ID. Leave empty to only copy to clipboard.
